title: Manti

items.item: meat, chopped (round steak or strip steak)

instructions: Combine chopped meat, onions, salt, and pepper.
Use a wet paper towel to dampen the dumpling wrappers.
Fill each dumpling with about 1 tablespoon of meat and seal the dumpling.
Put the dumplings on a tray lined with nonstick aluminum foil and freeze.
When ready to cook: boil water in the steamer and add about 1 tablespoon of salt to the boiling water.
Place the frozen dumplings on the steamer trays and steam for about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Put on a plate and spray some oil on each manti. Enjoy!
